title: Phone-based parent/child pairing UI with OTP and parent phone profile support

requirements.summary: Add child pairing option via parent phone number with SMS OTP verification, alongside existing 6-digit code pairing, including validation and UI error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend: The child pairing area offers two choices: (1) pair via 6-digit code (existing), (2) pair via parent phone number (new).

Frontend: The phone input enforces digits-only normalization and validates the exact mask length implied by (00)000000000 before submission; user-facing validation messages exist in i18n (en + pt-BR).

Frontend: After the child enters the OTP correctly, the backend links the child to that parent (same internal link structure used by the current pairing flow), and the child UI updates to the paired state (getMyParent reflects the parent).
Backend: Incorrect OTP, expired OTP, too many attempts, unknown/unregistered parent phone, or child already paired are all handled with explicit result codes and corresponding UI error messages.

file_operations.description: Extend the child pairing card UI to offer two selectable pairing methods (existing 6-digit code and new phone-number + OTP flow). Add a two-step phone pairing UX: (1) enter parent phone number in digits-only normalized form and submit to initiate verification, (2) enter 6-digit OTP and submit to complete verification. Keep the existing 6-digit code path intact and ensure paired state updates via existing getMyParent query behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add React Query mutations for phone pairing: a hook to initiate phone pairing (calling pairWithParentViaPhone) and a hook to complete OTP verification (calling completePhonePairing). On success, invalidate/refetch myParent (and relevant relationship queries) so the child UI transitions to paired state without manual refresh. Map PairWithParentResult codes related to phone verification into handled UI-consumable outcomes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create utilities for phone-number normalization and formatting: strip non-digits, enforce exact 11-digit length for the (00)000000000 mask, and provide a formatter for display. Use these helpers in the child phone pairing UI and parent profile phone field to ensure consistent validation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the updated pairing UI remains properly wired into the child home experience (PairWithParentCard shown when not paired). If the phone flow introduces additional local state, confirm it resets appropriately when myParent becomes available. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Allow parents/guardians to provide and update a phone number in their profile for phone-based pairing, with validation and without disrupting existing users.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend: Parents see a phone number field during profile setup or in an obvious profile/account area, with validation matching the required phone format; children do not need to provide a phone number for this feature to work.
Existing users without a phone number can continue using the app and the existing 6-digit pairing-code flow unchanged.

file_operations.description: Add an optional phone number field for parent/guardian role during initial profile setup. Validate against the required (00)000000000 mask length via shared normalization (digits-only, exactly 11 digits). Do not require phone for children. Save phoneNumber into the UserProfile only when provided. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a parent-facing account/profile card that displays the current phone number (if any) and allows adding/updating it. Use existing shadcn/ui composed components (Card, Input, Label, Button, Alert) without modifying frontend/src/components/ui. Leverage i18n strings and shared phone normalization utilities. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire ParentPhoneNumberCard into the parent dashboard in an obvious location (near pairing setup), so parents can add/update their phone number after onboarding. Ensure existing flows (pairing code generation, child selection) remain unchanged. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add/adjust i18n strings (en + pt-BR) for phone-based pairing, OTP verification, and updated pairing validation/error states.
acceptanceCriteria: All new user-visible labels, button text, help text, and error messages for phone-based pairing and OTP verification are sourced from i18n keys (en.ts and pt-BR.ts).
No hard-coded Portuguese user-facing strings are introduced in React components.

file_operations.description: Add English i18n keys for: phone pairing option labels, phone input label/placeholder/help, OTP step label/placeholder/help, submit/resend/cancel actions if present, and explicit error messages corresponding to phone pairing/OTP result codes (e.g., parentNotFound, phoneVerificationExpired, phoneVerificationFailed, too many attempts if exposed, alreadyPaired, phoneNumberAlreadyLinked). Also add parent phone profile field labels and validation messages. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add Portuguese (Brazil) equivalents for the new phone pairing + OTP + parent phone profile keys introduced in en.ts, ensuring all user-visible strings used by the new/updated UI are translated and referenced via i18n. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace/extend any new user-visible strings added for the phone pairing + OTP flow with i18n keys (no hard-coded Portuguese). Ensure validation and error rendering uses i18n messages. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure the parent phone profile UI uses i18n keys for all labels, help text, and validation/errors (no hard-coded Portuguese). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
